thread:
kevin: rolling v2024.11 -> canary 10% in us-east + eu-west. quick heads up: support pinged about weird token truncation in eu-west only. asking for an ops stop/go.

deploy-bot: deploy 2999990001 started by kevin — canary -> 10%. targets healthy 6/60. logs: tokenizer stream open.

ivy: i've reproduced a few truncations hitting eu-west edge nodes under high-concurrency tests. looks regional. us-east is clean.

mike: which runtime flags shipped? packaging shows safe_transform=false in the artifact for eu-west shard; other regions got the patched artifact with safe_transform=true. seems like a build stamping problem.

ops-runner: recommend immediate regional hold: keep us-east at 10% but pin eu-west traffic to v2024.10 (route pin) while we hotfix the artifact for eu-west. Alternatively, flip remote config `tokenizer.safe_transform=true` for rollout=canary in eu-west only and observe 15m. lower-risk to flip config if possible.

kevin: i'd prefer flip config for eu-west first. if that stabilizes we don't need a rollback. ivy, can you confirm the config controls the truncation?

ivy: yes the safe_transform flag replicates the packaged behavior that avoids in-place buffer reuse. flipping it should fix truncation.

deploy-bot: executing: `rwctl config set tokenizer.safe_transform=true --selector rollout=canary,region=eu-west`
deploy-bot: matched 3 targets (eu-west canary). applying...
deploy-bot: config applied to 3/3 targets. status=success. change-id=cfg-2999990001-eu

ops-runner: watching metrics. 6m in: eu-west truncation rate down from 1.4% -> 0.2%. p95 latency stable. recommend bake for 20m before rejoining eu-west to the ramp.

notes-bot: release notes draft missing a line about per-region artifact divergence. i pushed a short note to `release/v2024.11-notes`: "Hotfix: eu-west received old artifact; safe_transform enabled via runtime config during canary. Full packaging fix pending."

release-manager: change window open until 21:30 UTC. quick vote: :thumbsup: to proceed to re-include eu-west in the ramp after 20m bake, :thumbsdown: to keep pinned/rollback. mark votes.

kevin: :thumbsup: (after bake)

ivy: :thumbsup: (observed replays look good)

mike: :thumbsup: (will land packaging fix PR and ensure artifact stamping)

ops-runner: :thumbsup: (i'll keep alarms armed)

release-manager: consensus = rejoin after bake. annotating rollout with change-id and notes. schedule: unpin eu-west and resume ramp at ~2999991200 unless a hold is raised.

deploy-bot: annotate rollout 2999990001: "region-eu-west config flip applied (cfg-2999990001-eu); bake hold started"

kevin: thanks. mike, please coordinate packaging PR and add a preflight check so artifact stamp mismatch can't happen again.

mike: will open PR `ci/fix-artifact-stamp` and add a release pipeline assert.

ops-runner: if any new truncation spikes before the scheduled resume, call emergency:rollback and we'll pin eu-west back to v2024.10.

deploy-bot: scheduled action: unpin eu-west and continue ramp at 2999991200 (ETA ~19m).
